Using the **writing-great-skills** skill.

For a skill you only ever type by name — and that other skills must not auto-reach — make it **user-invoked**:

- Set `disable-model-invocation: true` in frontmatter.
- Keep `description` human-facing (short summary; strip trigger lists meant for model auto-fire).

That drops **context load** (the description is not always in the window) and spends **cognitive load** on you as the index. Model-invocation is only worth it when the agent must fire the skill on its own or another skill must reach it.
